title: ""

---

## Goal
Describe the exact change and expected user or system outcome.

## Current behaviour and affected components
Identify source paths, APIs, dependencies and reproduced behaviour (where applicable).

## Deliverable tasks
- [ ] Confirm current implementation, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Implement the specific functionality or defect fix described above.
- [ ] Cover validation, security, permissions, failure modes and regressions relevant to this issue.
- [ ] Add and run reproducible automated tests plus applicable integration checks.
- [ ] Verify the user-visible or operational outcome, record results and attach commit/PR evidence.
- [ ] Complete final review; confirm all acceptance criteria and check every task before closing.

## Acceptance criteria
Record observable, testable outcomes. Split the implementation checkbox into further specific tasks before beginning work.

## Verification evidence
PR/commit links, commands, actual test results and any deferred work. Do not check tasks without evidence.

## Related issues and dependencies
Link upstream and downstream issues where useful.
